{"metadata":{"description":"Unofficial Aseprite-compatible pixel editor and sprite animation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1338961191","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-aseprite","slug":"Ratevoid/dsh-aseprite","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Unofficial Aseprite-compatible pixel editor and sprite animation plugin for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-aseprite"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A pixel-art and sprite-animation editor plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It is compatible with Aseprite "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"project files and requires no Aseprite installation."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- 🎨 Adds a **🎨** button to the conversation header; click it to open or close the editor dock above "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"the message input.
- ✏️ Tools: pencil, eraser, bucket fill, picker, line, rectangle, and rectangular"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" region selection, with undo, redo, wheel zoom, grid, onion skinning, adjustable brush/eraser size, "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"and draggable left/right/top/bottom panel splitters.
- 🤖 Select a region, click **ASK**, describe a "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"local adjustment, and send an enlarged PNG crop plus the selection coordinates to the active DSH con"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"versation. The AI response is reviewed in chat; editor pixels are not changed automatically.
- 🧩 **B"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"lueprint workflows**: click 🧩 in the toolbar to open a ComfyUI-style visual node graph; drag nodes a"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"nd click input/output ports to connect them.
- **Passive blueprints** such as transparent cropping, "},{"id":"p5s9","text":"pixel outlines, and crop-plus-outline run locally, can be reused indefinitely after one creation, an"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"d never call the LLM.
- **Active blueprints** contain an LLM node and send the selected image plus n"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"ode prompt to the current conversation AI.
- Click **AI Create Blueprint** and describe a complete t"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"ask. The assistant's dsh-blueprint JSON is automatically parsed, validated, and stored in the browse"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"r library—no manual JSON copying. The library has UI import/export controls.
- 🧅 Layers: create, del"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"ete, reorder, and toggle visibility.
- 🎞️ Animation frames: add, duplicate, delete, set frame durati"},{"id":"p5s15","text":"on (ms), and preview playback.
- 🎨 Palettes: built-in DB16 and PICO-8-style 16-color palettes, custo"},{"id":"p5s16","text":"m colors, extra palettes, and color picking.
- 💾 Reads and writes **.aseprite project files** in pur"},{"id":"p5s17","text":"e JavaScript, with no Aseprite installation required; supports RGBA, grayscale, indexed-color readin"},{"id":"p5s18","text":"g, compressed cel decoding, current-frame PNG export, and sprite-sheet PNG export."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Canvas close-up:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The transparent canvas uses a standard square checkerboard:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Host** (`lib/index.js`): a minimal loader entry that exposes the `dsh.client` declaration; the e"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ditor runs entirely in the browser.
- **Client** (`client/client.js`): follows the `window.__ModuleL"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"oader__.load({ id, factory })` contract and registers the header button and dock through `ctx.slots`"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" at `conversation.session.header.actions` and `conversation.input.dock`.
- **Codec** (`src/ase-codec"},{"id":"p10s5","text":".js`): implements the Aseprite file format specification, writing 32bpp RGBA, raw cels, and modern p"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"alette chunks that Aseprite can open directly."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Project structure"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Development / build"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install locally"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add`. To reinstall manually:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Restart DeepSeek Harness after installation, then refresh the page. The 🎨 button in the conversation"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" header confirms that the plugin is loaded."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"If present, also remove the handwritten `aseprite` entry from the profile `cordis.patch.yml`, then r"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"estart the application."}],"truncated":false}
